title: SPEC-GXP-003 — Immutable Audit Ledger & Audit Review Events
description: WP-01 has no entries in 07_EVENT_CATALOGUE.yaml (a Phase-0 documentation gap, same class SG-013's own tracking note already flags for WP-01/07/08) -- events derived directly from app/modules/audit/commands.py's actual event_type= producer code, the same approach the WP-13 slice used for Document 105. 1 event found: AuditExportCreated. Document 03 (Mutation Gateway), Document 04 (Signature) and Document 07's own policy-evaluation path (app/modules/policy/) emit zero domain events of their own -- they are shared infrastructure (write_outbox_event/write_audit_event/resolve_signature_requirement) that every other module's own domain event is built on top of, not aggregate-owning modules themselves. This is architecturally correct, not a gap: verified by grepping every *.py file in app/modules/mutation, app/modules/signature and app/modules/policy for event_type= and finding none.
